sources.label: Plesa et al., Nature Aging — October 14, 2026; published research

research.summary: An old boat carries a new weather in its sails. Inspired by experiments in cultured human fibroblasts: inducing SRSF1 shifted ageing-related readouts while largely preserving tested cell-identity markers. Effects depended on the timing and duration of induction. The boat and its weather are an artistic metaphor for change within a retained identity, not evidence of rejuvenation in people.
